}\n91\tinline size_t blockStart(size_t idx, size_t B) { return idx * B; }\n92\tinline size_t blockLen(size_t idx, size_t n, size_t B) {\n93\t    const size_t start = idx * B;\n94\t    return std::min(B, n - start);\n95\t}\n96\t\n97\tstruct BlockMat {\n98\t    double* dptr = nullptr;\n99\t    size_t rows = 0;\n100\t    size_t cols = 0;\n101\t};\n102\t\n103\t// Per-OpenMP-thread CUDA resources: each host thread gets its own stream and\n104\t// cuBLAS handle so independent blocks can be processed concurrently on the GPU.\n105\tstruct ThreadCudaCtx {\n106\t    bool initialized = false;\n107\t    cublasHandle_t handle = nullptr;\n108\t    cudaStream_t stream = nullptr;\n109\t};\n110\t\n111\tThreadCudaCtx& threadCudaCtx(int deviceId) {\n112\t    static thread_local ThreadCudaCtx ctx;\n113\t    if (!ctx.initialized) {\n114\t        CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(deviceId));\n115\t        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreate(&ctx.stream));\n116\t        CUBLAS_CHECK(cublasCreate(&ctx.handle));\n117\t        CUBLAS_CHECK(cublasSetStream(ctx.handle, ctx.stream));\n118\t        ctx.initialized = true;\n119\t    }\n120\t    return ctx;\n121\t}\n122\t\n123\tvoid extractBlock(const std::vector<double>& A, size_t n, size_t rowStart, size_t rowLen,\n124\t                   size_t colStart, size_t colLen, std::vector<double>& buf) {\n125\t    buf.resize(rowLen * colLen);\n126\t    for (size_t r = 0; r < rowLen; ++r) {\n127\t        std::memcpy(&buf[r * colLen], &A[(rowStart + r) * n + colStart], colLen * sizeof(double));\n128\t    }\n129\t}\n130\t\n131\tvoid insertBlock(std::vector<double>& A, size_t n, size_t rowStart, size_t rowLen,\n132\t                  size_t colStart, size_t colLen, const std::vector<double>& buf) {\n133\t    for (size_t r = 0; r < rowLen; ++r) {\n134\t        std::memcpy(&A[(rowStart + r) * n + colStart], &buf[r * colLen], colLen * sizeof(double));\n135\t    }\n136\t}\n137\t\n138\t// Distributed, GPU-accelerated Cholesky decomposition.\n139\t// Only rank 0's `A` is meaningful as input/output; all ranks must call this\n140\t// function collectively. On success, rank 0's `A` holds L (lower triangular,\n141\t// upper part zeroed), matching the semantics of choleskyDecomposition().\n142\tbool choleskyDecompositionDistributed(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n, MPI_Comm comm) {\n143\t    int rank = 0, nprocs = 1;\n144\t    MPI_Comm_rank(comm, &rank);\n145\t    MPI_Comm_size(comm, &nprocs);\n146\t\n147\t    // Map ranks to GPUs using node-local rank, so multi-node clusters spread\n148\t    // ranks across the GPUs available on each node.\n149\t    MPI_Comm nodeComm;\n150\t    MPI_Comm_split_type(comm, MPI_COMM_TYPE_SHARED, rank, MPI_INFO_NULL, &nodeComm);\n151\t    int localRank = 0, localSize = 1;\n152\t    MPI_Comm_rank(nodeComm, &localRank);\n153\t    MPI_Comm_size(nodeComm, &localSize);\n154\t    MPI_Comm_free(&nodeComm);\n155\t\n156\t    // Each rank only needs enough host threads to fan its own independent\n157\t    // GPU work (TRSM/GEMM/SYRK calls) across CUDA streams; oversubscribing\n158\t    // with the full node core count per rank hurts multi-rank-per-node runs.\n159\t    const int originalMaxThreads = omp_get_max_threads();\n160\t    const int coresPerNode = omp_get_num_procs();\n161\t    const int threadsPerRank = std::max(1, std::min(16, coresPerNode / std::max(1, localSize)));\n162\t    omp_set_num_threads(threadsPerRank);\n163\t\n164\t    int deviceCount = 0;\n165\t    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceCount(&deviceCount));\n166\t    if (deviceCount <= 0) {\n167\t        if (rank == 0) fprintf(stderr, \"No CUDA devices available\\n\");\n168\t        MPI_Abort(comm, 1);\n169\t    }\n170\t    const int deviceId = localRank % deviceCount;\n171\t    CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(deviceId));\n172\t\n173\t    const size_t B = BLOCK_SIZE;\n174\t    const size_t nb = numBlocks(n, B);\n175\t\n176\t    // localCol[j] holds the blocks (i, j) for i = j..nb-1, only populated for\n177\t    // block-columns j owned by this rank (owner(j) == j % nprocs).\n178\t    std::vector<std::vector<BlockMat>> localCol(nb);\n179\t    auto owner = [nprocs](size_t j) -> int { return (int)(j % (size_t)nprocs); };\n180\t    auto getBlock = [&localCol](size_t j, size_t i) -> BlockMat& { return localCol[j][i - j]; };\n181\t\n182\t    for (size_t j = 0; j < nb; ++j) {\n183\t        if (owner(j) == rank) {\n184\t            const size_t cj = blockLen(j, n, B);\n185\t            localCol[j].resize(nb - j);\n186\t            for (size_t i = j; i < nb; ++i) {\n187\t                const size_t ri = blockLen(i, n, B);\n188\t                double* d = nullptr;\n189\t                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d, ri * cj * sizeof(double)));\n190\t                localCol[j][i - j] = BlockMat{d, ri, cj};\n191\t            }\n192\t        }\n193\t    }\n194\t\n195\t    // --- Distribute blocks from rank 0 to their owning ranks ---\n196\t    for (size_t j = 0; j < nb; ++j) {\n197\t        const int ownerJ = owner(j);\n198\t        const size_t cj = blockLen(j, n, B);\n199\t        for (size_t i = j; i < nb; ++i) {\n200\t            const size_t ri = blockLen(i, n, B);\n201\t            const int tag = (int)(i * nb + j);\n202\t            if (rank == 0) {\n203\t                std::vector<double> buf;\n204\t                extractBlock(A, n, blockStart(i, B), ri, blockStart(j, B), cj, buf);\n205\t                if (ownerJ == 0) {\n206\t                    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(getBlock(j, i).dptr, buf.data(), ri * cj * sizeof(double),\n207\t                                           cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n208\t                } else {\n209\t                    MPI_Send(buf.data(), (int)(ri * cj), MPI_DOUBLE, ownerJ, tag, comm);\n210\t                }\n211\t            } else if (rank == ownerJ) {\n212\t                std::vector<double> buf(ri * cj);\n213\t                MPI_Recv(buf.data(), (int)(ri * cj), MPI_DOUBLE, 0, tag, comm, MPI_STATUS_IGNORE);\n214\t                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(getBlock(j, i).dptr, buf.data(), ri * cj * sizeof(double),\n215\t                                       cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n216\t            }\n217\t        }\n218\t    }\n219\t\n220\t    // Persistent scratch buffer for the broadcast panel on non-owner ranks,\n221\t    // sized for the largest possible panel (n rows x B columns). Reused every\n222\t    // iteration to avoid expensive cudaMalloc/cudaFree calls in the hot loop.\n223\t    double* panelScratch = nullptr;\n224\t    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&panelScratch, n * B * sizeof(double)));\n225\t\n226\t    bool failed = false;\n227\t\n228\t    // --- Right-looking blocked factorization ---\n229\t    for (size_t k = 0; k < nb && !failed; ++k) {\n230\t        const int ownerK = owner(k);\n231\t        const size_t rk = blockLen(k, n, B);\n232\t\n233\t        int failFlag = 0;\n234\t        if (rank == ownerK) {\n235\t            BlockMat& Lkk = getBlock(k, k);\n236\t            std::vector<double> hostBlock(rk * rk);\n237\t            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hostBlock.data(), Lkk.dptr, rk * rk * sizeof(double),\n238\t                                   cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n239\t            const bool ok = choleskyDecomposition(hostBlock, rk);\n240\t            failFlag = ok ? 0 : 1;\n241\t            if (ok) {\n242\t                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(Lkk.dptr, hostBlock.data(), rk * rk * sizeof(double),\n243\t                                       cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n244\t            }\n245\t        }\n246\t        MPI_Bcast(&failFlag, 1, MPI_INT, ownerK, comm);\n247\t        if (failFlag) {\n248\t            failed = true;\n249\t            break;\n250\t        }\n251\t\n252\t        // Panel: solve L(i,k) = A(i,k) * L(k,k)^-T for all i > k owned by ownerK.\n253\t        if (rank == ownerK) {\n254\t            BlockMat& Lkk = getBlock(k, k);\n255\t            #pragma omp parallel for schedule(dynamic)\n256\t            for (size_t i = k + 1; i < nb; ++i) {\n257\t                ThreadCudaCtx& ctx = threadCudaCtx(deviceId);\n258\t                BlockMat& Bik = getBlock(k, i);\n259\t                const double alpha = 1.0;\n260\t                CUBLAS_CHECK(cublasDtrsm(ctx.handle, CUBLAS_SIDE_LEFT, CUBLAS_FILL_MODE_UPPER,\n261\t                                          CUBLAS_OP_T, CUBLAS_DIAG_NON_UNIT, (int)rk, (int)Bik.rows,\n262\t                                          &alpha, Lkk.dptr, (int)rk, Bik.dptr, (int)rk));\n263\t                CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(ctx.stream));\n264\t            }\n265\t        }\n266\t\n267\t        // Broadcast the whole panel (blocks (k..nb-1, k)) to every rank.\n268\t        std::vector<size_t> rows(nb);\n269\t        std::vector<size_t> offset(nb, 0);\n270\t        size_t totalElems = 0;\n271\t        for (size_t i = k; i < nb; ++i) {\n272\t            rows[i] = blockLen(i, n, B);\n273\t            offset[i] = totalElems;\n274\t            totalElems += rows[i] * rk;\n275\t        }\n276\t\n277\t        std::vector<double> panelHost(totalElems);\n278\t        if (rank == ownerK) {\n279\t            for (size_t i = k; i < nb; ++i) {\n280\t                BlockMat& b = getBlock(k, i);\n281\t                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(panelHost.data() + offset[i], b.dptr,\n282\t                                       rows[i] * rk * sizeof(double), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n283\t            }\n284\t        }\n285\t        MPI_Bcast(panelHost.data(), (int)totalElems, MPI_DOUBLE, ownerK, comm);\n286\t\n287\t        std::vector<double*> panelDev(nb, nullptr);\n288\t        if (rank == ownerK) {\n289\t            for (size_t i = k; i < nb; ++i) {\n290\t                panelDev[i] = getBlock(k, i).dptr;\n291\t            }\n292\t        } else {\n293\t            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(panelScratch, panelHost.data(), totalElems * sizeof(double),\n294\t                                   cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n295\t            for (size_t i = k; i < nb; ++i) {\n296\t                panelDev[i] = panelScratch + offset[i];\n297\t            }\n298\t        }\n299\t\n300\t        // Trailing update: for every block-column j > k owned by this rank,\n301\t        // A(i,j) -= L(i,k) * L(j,k)^T  for i = j..nb-1 (SYRK on the diagonal,\n302\t        // GEMM off-diagonal). Independent columns are fanned out over OpenMP\n303\t        // threads, each driving its own CUDA stream.\n304\t        std::vector<size_t> myCols;\n305\t        for (size_t j = k + 1; j < nb; ++j) {\n306\t            if (owner(j) == rank) myCols.push_back(j);\n307\t        }\n308\t\n309\t        #pragma omp parallel for schedule(dynamic)\n310\t        for (size_t idx = 0; idx < myCols.size(); ++idx) {\n311\t            const size_t j = myCols[idx];\n312\t            ThreadCudaCtx& ctx = threadCudaCtx(deviceId);\n313\t            const size_t cj = blockLen(j, n, B);\n314\t            double* Ljk = panelDev[j];\n315\t            const double alpha = -1.0, beta = 1.0;\n316\t            for (size_t i = j; i < nb; ++i) {\n317\t                const size_t ri = blockLen(i, n, B);\n318\t                BlockMat& Cij = getBlock(j, i);\n319\t                double* Lik = panelDev[i];\n320\t                if (i == j) {\n321\t                    CUBLAS_CHECK(cublasDsyrk(ctx.handle, CUBLAS_FILL_MODE_UPPER, CUBLAS_OP_T,\n322\t                                              (int)cj, (int)rk, &alpha, Ljk, (int)rk, &beta,\n323\t                                              Cij.dptr, (int)cj));\n324\t                } else {\n325\t                    CUBLAS_CHECK(cublasDgemm(ctx.handle, CUBLAS_OP_T, CUBLAS_OP_N, (int)cj, (int)ri,\n326\t                                              (int)rk, &alpha, Ljk, (int)rk, Lik, (int)rk, &beta,\n327\t                                              Cij.dptr, (int)cj));\n328\t                }\n329\t            }\n330\t            CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(ctx.stream));\n331\t        }\n332\t    }\n333\t\n334\t    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(panelScratch));\n335\t\n336\t    // --- Gather the result back to rank 0 ---\n337\t    if (!failed) {\n338\t        for (size_t j = 0; j < nb; ++j) {\n339\t            const int ownerJ = owner(j);\n340\t            const size_t cj = blockLen(j, n, B);\n341\t            for (size_t i = j; i < nb; ++i) {\n342\t                const size_t ri = blockLen(i, n, B);\n343\t                const int tag = (int)(i * nb + j);\n344\t                if (rank == 0) {\n345\t                    std::vector<double> buf(ri * cj);\n346\t                    if (ownerJ == 0) {\n347\t                        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(buf.data(), getBlock(j, i).dptr, ri * cj * sizeof(double),\n348\t                                               cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n349\t                    } else {\n350\t                        MPI_Recv(buf.data(), (int)(ri * cj), MPI_DOUBLE, ownerJ, tag, comm,\n351\t                                  MPI_STATUS_IGNORE);\n352\t                    }\n353\t                    insertBlock(A, n, blockStart(i, B), ri, blockStart(j, B), cj, buf);\n354\t                } else if (rank == ownerJ) {\n355\t                    std::vector<double> buf(ri * cj);\n356\t                    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(buf.data(), getBlock(j, i).dptr, ri * cj * sizeof(double),\n357\t                                           cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n358\t                    MPI_Send(buf.data(), (int)(ri * cj), MPI_DOUBLE, 0, tag, comm);\n359\t                }\n360\t            }\n361\t        }\n362\t\n363\t        if (rank == 0) {\n364\t            #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n365\t            for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n366\t                for (size_t j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {\n367\t                    A[i * n + j] = 0.0;\n368\t                }\n369\t            }\n370\t        }\n371\t    }\n372\t\n373\t    for (size_t j = 0; j < nb; ++j) {\n374\t        for (auto& b : localCol[j]) {\n375\t            CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(b.dptr));\n376\t        }\n377\t    }\n378\t\n379\t    omp_set_num_threads(originalMaxThreads);\n380\t    return !failed;\n381\t}\n382\t\n383\t}  // namespace hybrid\n384\t\n385\t// Generate a symmetric positive definite matrix\n386\tvoid generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n) {\n387\t    // Method: Create A = B * B^T where B is random\n388\t    // This guarantees A is positive semi-definite\n389\t    // Then add identity to make it strictly positive definite\n390\t\n391\t    std::vector<double> B(n * n);\n392\t    unsigned int seed = 42;\n393\t\n394\t    // Generate random matrix B (kept sequential to preserve the deterministic\n395\t    // random stream produced by rand_r)\n396\t    for (size_t i = 0; i < n * n; ++i) {\n397\t        B[i] = (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 0.5;\n398\t    }\n399\t\n400\t    // Compute A = B * B^T (element order preserved per (i,j); only independent\n401\t    // outer iterations are parallelized, so results are unaffected)\n402\t    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n403\t    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n404\t        for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n405\t            double sum = 0.0;\n406\t            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n407\t                sum += B[i * n + k] * B[j * n + k];\n408\t            }\n409\t            A[i * n + j] = sum;\n410\t        }\n411\t    }\n412\t\n413\t    // Add diagonal dominance to ensure positive definiteness\n414\t    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n415\t        A[i * n + i] += n;\n416\t    }\n417\t}\n418\t\n419\tbool validateCholesky(const std::vector<double>& L, const std::vector<double>& A_orig, const size_t n) {\n420\t    // Validate by computing L * L^T and comparing with original matrix\n421\t\n422\t    std::vector<double> reconstructed(n * n);\n423\t\n424\t    // Compute L * L^T\n425\t    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n426\t    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n427\t        for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n428\t            double sum = 0.0;\n429\t            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n430\t                sum += L[i * n + k] * L[j * n + k];\n431\t            }\n432\t            reconstructed[i * n + j] = sum;\n433\t        }\n434\t    }\n435\t\n436\t    // Compare with original\n437\t    double maxError = 0.0;\n438\t    double relError = 0.0;\n439\t\n440\t    for (size_t i = 0; i < n * n; ++i) {\n441\t        const double error = fabs(reconstructed[i] - A_orig[i]);\n442\t        maxError = std::max(maxError, error);\n443\t\n444\t        const double rel = error / (fabs(A_orig[i]) + 1e-10);\n445\t        relError = std::max(relError, rel);\n446\t    }\n447\t\n448\t    printf(\"Max absolute error: %.10e\\n\", maxError);\n449\t    printf(\"Max relative error: %.10e\\n\", relError);\n450\t\n451\t    // Check if error is within tolerance\n452\t    if (relError > 1e-6) {\n453\t        printf(\"Validation failed: relative error too large\\n\");\n454\t        return false;\n455\t    }\n456\t\n457\t    return true;\n458\t}\n459\t\n460\tvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n461\t    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n462\t    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n463\t    printf(\"  -n <num>     Matrix size (default: 512)\\n\");\n464\t    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n465\t    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n466\t    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n467\t}\n468\t\n469\tint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n470\t    int provided = 0;\n471\t    MPI_Init_thread(&argc, &argv, MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED, &provided);\n472\t\n473\t std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(end - start);\n547\t\n548\t    if (!success) {\n549\t        if (rank == 0) printf(\"Cholesky decomposition failed\\n\");\n550\t print_results(A, \"CholeskyL\");\n569\t    }\n570\t\n571\t    // Validation\n572\t    if (validate) {\n573\t        printf(\"Validating result...\\n\");\n574\t        bool valid = validateCholesky(A, Reused every\n    // iteration to avoid expensive cudaMalloc/cudaFree calls in the hot loop.\n    double* panelScratch = nullptr;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&panelScratch, n * B * sizeof(double)));\n\n    bool failed = false;\n\n    // --- Right-looking blocked factorization ---\n    for (size_t k = 0; i < nb; ++i) {\n            rows[i] = blockLen(i, n, B);\n            offset[i] = totalElems;\n            totalElems += rows[i] * rk;\n        }\n\n        std::vector<double> panelHost(totalElems);\n        if (rank == ownerK) {\n            for (size_t i = k; i < nb; ++i) {\n                BlockMat& b = getBlock(k, i);\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(panelHost.data() + offset[i], b.dptr,\n                                       rows[i] * rk * sizeof(double), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n            }\n        }\n        MPI_Bcast(panelHost.data(), (int)totalElems, MPI_DOUBLE, ownerK, comm);\n\n        std::vector<double*> panelDev(nb, nullptr);\n        if (rank == ownerK) {\n            for (size_t i = k; i < nb; ++i) {\n                panelDev[i] = getBlock(k, i).dptr;\n            }\n        } else {\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(panelScratch, panelHost.data(), totalElems * sizeof(double),\n                                   cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n            for (size_t i = k; i < nb; ++i) {\n                panelDev[i] = panelScratch + offset[i];\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Trailing update: for every block-column j > k owned by this rank,\n        // A(i,j) -= L(i,k) * L(j,k)^T  for i = j..nb-1 (SYRK on the diagonal,\n        // GEMM off-diagonal). Independent columns are fanned out over OpenMP\n        // threads, each driving its own CUDA stream.\n        std::vector<size_t> myCols;\n        for (size_t j = k + 1; j < nb; ++j) {\n            if (owner(j) == rank) myCols.push_back(j);\n        }\n\n        #pragma omp parallel for schedule(dynamic)\n        for (size_t idx = 0;
